title: Immersed craft
description: A Minecraft base modpack focused on improved atmosphere, exploration, and gameplay while staying lightweight and easy to expand. Designed to serve as a solid foundation for adding more mods and customizing the experience however you want.
body:
**_A lightweight immersive Minecraft base modpack focused on atmosphere and gameplay enhancement._**

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Important

> This modpack is designed as a lightweight foundation that can easily be expanded with additional mods and customization.

> The pack is still actively being updated and refined.

**None of the included mods or resource packs are owned by me.**  
All rights belong to their respective creators.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Performance

> This modpack includes multiple optimization mods to keep performance stable while improving visuals and gameplay.

## Features

✔ Improved atmosphere and environmental visuals.  
✔ Lightweight and performance-friendly setup.  
✔ Visual and audio improvements.  
✔ Designed to work as a customizable base for adding more mods.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## ⭐ What makes this modpack worth downloading?

This modpack focuses on improving the overall Minecraft experience without heavily changing the core game. It provides a lightweight immersive base that can be expanded and customized however you want.
